dependencies.version_range: any release whose contract declares the tools and flags below (capability detection)

located_by: the Python environment of this skill

dependencies.install: download the deep-filter binary for your platform from https://github.com/Rikorose/DeepFilterNet/releases (v0.5.x, for example deep-filter-0.5.6-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl) and DeepFilterNet3_onnx.tar.gz from https://github.com/Rikorose/DeepFilterNet/raw/v0.5.6/models/DeepFilterNet3_onnx.tar.gz, then put deep-filter on PATH (or set VOICE_ENHANCE_DEEP_FILTER) and set VOICE_ENHANCE_DFN_MODEL to the model tarball
dependencies.weights_license: MIT OR Apache-2.0 (checkpoints are files of the same repository)

located_by: the Python environment of this skill

crosstalk.attribution: voice-enhance-skill crosstalk engine (ADR-005), MIT; computes with NumPy (BSD-3-Clause)
crosstalk.description: Microphone bleed reduction for time-aligned per-mic tracks: dominance-gated least-squares coupling and per-bin linear demixing (NumPy, no model weights)
located_by: the Python environment of this skill

deepfilternet.attribution: DeepFilterNet by Hendrik Schröter (https://github.com/Rikorose/DeepFilterNet), MIT OR Apache-2.0
deepfilternet.description: DeepFilterNet3 noise suppression (full band, 48 kHz) via the standalone deep-filter binary
deepfilternet.install: download the deep-filter binary for your platform from https://github.com/Rikorose/DeepFilterNet/releases (v0.5.x, for example deep-filter-0.5.6-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl) and DeepFilterNet3_onnx.tar.gz from https://github.com/Rikorose/DeepFilterNet/raw/v0.5.6/models/DeepFilterNet3_onnx.tar.gz, then put deep-filter on PATH (or set VOICE_ENHANCE_DEEP_FILTER) and set VOICE_ENHANCE_DFN_MODEL to the model tarball
deepfilternet.weights_license: MIT OR Apache-2.0 (checkpoints are files of the same repository)

nara_wpe.attribution: nara_wpe by the Paderborn University Communications Engineering group (https://github.com/fgnt/nara_wpe), MIT
nara_wpe.description: WPE dereverberation (nara_wpe, offline iterative), single- or multi-channel; no model weights
located_by: the Python environment of this skill

execution.engine_process: worker subprocess in its own process group, killed on --timeout; Hugging Face libraries forced offline
execution.offline_flag: accepted everywhere; every registered engine already works with no network
execution.overwrites: never unless --overwrite; an output equal to an input is refused

not_provided: traditional (non-AI) noise reduction, gain, loudness, mixing, silence and filler removal (audio-production-skill)
generative re-synthesis of the voice (ADR-001: faithful, not generative)
downloading engines or model weights (one-time manual step; doctor says how)
network access of any kind at run time
direct ffmpeg calls (every media step is an ffmpeg-skill tool)

tools.description: Voice stem of a recording with noise and background removed (AI, DeepFilterNet3)

output.alignment: sample-aligned with the input (deep-filter -D compensates its delay)

tools.description: Speech with room reverberation reduced (WPE, nara_wpe)

output.alignment: sample-aligned with the input (WPE subtracts a prediction; no delay is added)
output.channels: same as the input stream (multi-channel WPE)

tools.description: Per-microphone tracks with cross-talk from the other microphones reduced (signal processing, no model weights)

input.sample_rate: one rate for all tracks (the first track's)
input.tracks: 2-8 time-aligned microphone tracks: the audio streams of one file (all, or --audio-streams), or one stream per file (stream 0, or one --audio-streams entry per file)

output.alignment: sample-aligned with each input (linear per-bin demixing; no delay is added)

tools.description: Put a cleaned stem back into its video: the video stream copied packet for packet, the stem as the only audio stream (ffmpeg-skill/audio --replace)

input.stem: any audio file ffmpeg-skill reads (its first audio stream is used)
input.video: a file with exactly one video stream; more than one audio stream only with --drop-other-audio

output.audio: the stem as the only audio stream, encoded by the container (AAC for .mp4 / .mov / .mkv), padded with silence or trimmed to the input's duration

tools.description: What is installed and missing (engines, ffmpeg-skill) and how to get it; never downloads
Registered engines with status, version, licences and attribution
